Sam P: Quick async check-in — milestone scrub for OKR M1. Paste 1) what we shipped this week, 2) what slipped, 3) one-line blocker & owner. Need this for the weekly rollup. @channel
Alex G: Shipped: v2 tokenizer fix (prod edge case), canary rolled. Docs update landed. Slipped: batching optimizer PR (waiting infra review). Blocker: infra approval for new GPU pool — owner: infra-team (Jordan).
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to us-west succeeded — 2.1% error rate, no regressions.
Priya K: Shipped: telem hooks for routing metrics. Slipped: canary settings for A/B rollout (need perf signal). Blocker: perf signal missing for long tails — owner: eng-sre (Maya).
Jordan L: Ack — infra approval: I pinged cloud-perms and infra rotation. ETA Monday AM to grant pool; will follow up on Alex's PR review.
Maya R: For the perf signal I can spin a short eval job. Need sample prompts + target latency. Priya, can you drop 5 example prompts here?
Priya K: Sure — posted as gist: https://gist.github.com/priya/abcd1234 : short convo + long prompt examples.
Alex G: CR pings: @Jordan L — PTAL at PR #412; it's blocking release. Small change, just infra permission bits.
Jordan L: On it. If I can't approve today, will delegate to Nate.
Sam P: Great — I'll assemble these into the rollup. Action items: Jordan -> infra approval (Mon), Jordan/Nate -> review PR #412 (ASAP), Maya -> perf eval (needs prompts), Alex/Priya -> update status by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
